entities.summary: Sharjeel Imam (b. 1988, Kako, Bihar) was a social reformer or activist of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Kako, Bihar and India. Known in the fields of india, activists & reformers, asia.
